title: You Are the Film (HKAFF)
synopsis:
Madoka is a playwright in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo and Kazuma is a band member in the neighbouring town of Sangenjaya. One day, in their own separate lives, they decide to go and see a movie at Tollywood, an independent cinema in Shimokitazawa. In the movie they each see, they see the other person on the screen. In other words, to Madoka, Kazuma is the "film" she is watching, and to Kazuma, Madoka is the "film" he is watching. In this impossible structure, incidents occur within each other's stories, just like in a film. Kazuma and Madoka communicate through the screen and work hard to solve the problems that arise in each other's story.
 

White Raven and Audience Award, Brussels International Fantastic Film Festival
